text:
emily: Heads-up — seeing elevated 502/503 auth failures originating from eu-west1 ingress since ~10:15UTC. Affects token issuance and auth proxy; rough impact ~2% of requests, largest hit for hosted APIs and some Dedicated customers. Investigating now. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3265004321 — investigating (initial).
raj: Oncall here. Hypothesis: recent ingress auth proxy config push caused upstream rate-limit spikes. I'm starting rollback of that config in eu-west1.
kai: Rolling back config patch on eu-west1 now (deploy id: rollback-2026-03-23-1018). ETA ~5–10m.
ops-bot: Rollback job started on eu-west1-edge-group-a at 10:19UTC. (monitoring job launched)
anita: Support draft banner ready: "We're investigating intermittent auth and token failures in EU. Engineers are rolling back a config change; we'll update shortly." Recommend publish once rollback shows improvement. :speech_balloon:
max: Please also escalate to PGT for accounts experiencing errors (cc: exec support). I'll ping the top 5 affected customers.
emily: Publishing support banner and creating customer incident note now. Status link (public): https://status.redwood.ai/incident/3265004321 — internal notes + runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/ingress-auth
ops-bot: Rollback completed on eu-west1-edge-group-a at 10:22UTC. Metrics: auth 5xx count down 72% vs peak.
raj: Enabling fallback routing for priority traffic to central auth cluster while we continue verification. Fallback applied to enterprise/critical routes.
kai: Fallback in place — ~12% of EU traffic shifted to central auth. Success rate for shifted traffic is >99.5%; added latency ~30ms.
emily: Current status: mitigation in place (rollback + targeted fallback). User-facing impact reduced to <0.1% of requests. Monitoring for 30m; if stable we'll start post-incident triage.
max: Notifying impacted customers + PGs. Will prepare a follow-up update for customer comms.
anita: Support ack — triage doc linked in the status incident.
incident-bot: Next update scheduled in 15m or on significant changes.
emily: Thanks all. If anyone sees regressions or anomalies, post here and tag @raj. We'll publish a full RCA after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
